definition: The plate is drawn from the pack's own figures and nothing else: each band is a member at the height and projection the record states, its profile constructed by rule, never traced. A carved profile that cannot be constructed is drawn plain and says so.
basis: Our wording of how a plate's profiles are made, from the moulding-geometry module and the grammar layer. build/profiles.py: "every shape below is drawn from the member's own two numbers by a rule named in its docstring."; build/profiles.py: "Nothing here traces a photograph or fits a curve to one"; build/profiles.py: "These return a plain swelling and set `unconstructed`, so a caller can say so."; docs/proportion.md: "from the member's own height and projection, never a curve fitted to look right"; docs/proportion.md: "these draw as a swelling and report themselves unconstructed so a caller can say so on the sheet"; docs/proportion.md: "A drawing generated from the data cannot silently disagree with the dimensions taken from it".
